headline.description: Ridge with nested feature selection: inside every outer leave-one-battery-out fold, greedy backward elimination over the feature set and the ridge penalty, scored by inner leave-one-battery-out MAE on the training cells only.

pre_registration.statement: The headline specification and the nested-selection procedure were fixed in configs/benchmark.yaml before any ridge_nfs result was computed (plain-ridge results for the same feature set and mode were already known); they are reported whatever they show. Other rows are secondary or labelled post hoc.

nested_selection.scoring: mean inner leave-one-battery-out MAE over the training cells
nested_selection.search: greedy backward elimination; stop when no removal improves

window_sweep.note: Exploratory sensitivity analysis. The registry windows (discharge 3.80->3.50 V, charge 3.90->4.19 V) were fixed before this sweep and are not selected from it. Rows: QC-valid core cycles where the window is measurable; relative mode excludes each cell's reference cycles from fitting and scoring.

loco.note: Conformal calibration groups are conditions (inner leave-one-condition-out over the two training conditions); ridge_nfs still selects by inner leave-one-battery-out.

notes: Protocol: whole batteries (or whole operating conditions for LOCO) are held out; train/test disjointness is asserted on every fold.
mae, rmse, bias: mean over held-out batteries of the per-battery value (each battery counts once); r2: pooled over all scored out-of-fold predictions; worst_mae: worst battery.

Coverage and mean width: mean over held-out batteries. 'cv' = full-model prediction +/- the conformal quantile of pooled leave-one-battery-out residuals of the training cells (what the production bundle ships); 'cv_plus' = group CV+ (Barber et al. 2021).
Conformal calibration uses only the training batteries of each outer fold; the held-out battery never enters fitting, feature selection, penalty tuning or calibration.
ridge_nfs (the pre-specified headline model) selects features and the ridge penalty by inner leave-one-battery-out MAE inside each outer training fold.

Relative mode: indicators divided by the cell's own mean over its first n_reference_cycles QC-valid measurements; those reference cycles are excluded from training, calibration and scoring. mae_non_reference gives the absolute-mode MAE on the same non-reference cycles.
post_hoc = feature set defined after seeing leave-one-battery-out results (diagnostic ablation, not a valid model selection). leaky = uses label-side information (sanity check).
